Hi Soojin,

We're ready to be added to Redwood's vendor roster so procurement can raise POs for the January device orders. Attached are the basic items AP usually needs — legal name, tax ID, remit address, and an AP contact. Can you confirm what additional fields your vendor master team needs so we can prepare a single package?

Quick answers:
- Legal name: Acme Instruments, Inc.
- Tax ID: 12-3456789
- Remit address: 1100 Meridian Ave, Suite 300, San Mateo, CA 94401
- Preferred invoice email: procurement@acmeinc.com

We also have a W-9 and articles of incorporation — I can send both as PDF. If Redwood needs a primary PO steward (the person who receives POs and handles invoice routing), who should we list?

Thanks — want to get this live before the next order window on Friday.

Best,
Lydia Chang
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Instruments

Subject: Re: New supplier setup request: Acme Instruments

Hi Lydia — thanks for the quick package.

Couple of things to speed this along:
1) Can you fill out the attached vendor onboarding form (one page) and return it — it captures beneficial owner, remittance ACH (if you want ACH), and PO acknowledgement preference. I've attached a fillable PDF: vendor-onboarding-form-fillable.pdf.
2) Our PO steward field is the person Redwood will send POs to; please list the procurement inbox (procurement@acmeinc.com) and a primary contact for operational questions — we recommend someone who handles order confirmations so we can close the loop quickly.
3) Tax classification: please confirm if you are operating as C-Corp / S-Corp / LLC taxed as corporation etc.

Internally cc'd is Kimberly from AP and Marissa from vendor master operations — they'll handle the profile creation and any follow-ups. Once we have the filled form + W-9 + certificate, AP will create the vendor record and confirm the ERP vendor id; typical turnaround is 48 hours.

If you prefer, I can also open a DocuSign envelope for signatures — tell me and I'll send it over.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Supplier Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachment: vendor-onboarding-form-fillable.pdf (PDF, 85 KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>

Kimberly / Marissa — forwarding Acme's initial note. They attached a W-9 and company certificate and will return the filled onboarding form later today.

Action items: 
- Marissa: please provision a vendor master draft (legal name exactly as provided) and flag for ACH if they return bank details in the form. We need the vendor profile to include: legal name, DBA (if any), tax ID, remit address, primary AP email, PO acknowledgement method (email vs portal), and primary PO steward.
- Kimberly: once Marissa marks the draft as ready, can AP create the vendor record in our ERP and confirm the vendor_id back to me (copy Lydia)? We'd like to have vendor_id before Friday's order window.

I will monitor the inbound filled form and ask Lydia for tax classification if it's missing.

Thanks — Soojin
(Onward to get this live quickly.)
